get.description: Same-origin authenticated WebSocket hints. REST is authoritative. Bounded queues, permission rechecks and explicit resync required on gap/expiry.

ApiToken.description: Scoped API token, separate from browser Session and never a mgrd Auth Grant.

Id.description: Management UUIDv4. Names and OVS row UUIDs are separate identities.

RequestId.description: UUIDv7; new-command age and epoch are validated before admission.

Revision.description: Opaque equality token; never sort or increment.

Sequence.description: Monotonic only within the same resource.

VlanInput.description: Empty trunks retains native all-VLAN meaning. dot1q-tunnel is Advanced and capability/validator gated. Ordinary UI accepts VLAN 1..4094; observations retain native 0/4095.

csrf_token.description: Session-bound CSRF value; not a mgrd grant. Do not log.
